採用・広告の製品.quote: The Trade Up Program helps clients buy a New Home first, move once, and sell their Old Home later.

Our flagship solution, the UpEquity Trade Up program, helps homeowners who are buying and selling at the same time. We specialize in unlocking equity and removing contingencies so that you can make a competitive, winning offer on your next home before selling your current one.

All-cash offers are now incredibly common — and some experts predict they’re here to stay. Lenders who thrived in the past may not fare as well without rethinking how they manufacture loans. UpEquity runs more like a tech startup than a mortgage company, and that thinking is what led them to Candor.

UpEquity is a digital mortgage company that specializes in transforming everyday homebuyers into cash buyers. Its flagship “Buy With Cash” and “Buy Before You Sell” programs aim to help homebuyers rally against the rising wave of cash offers in the mortgage marketplace.

“Historically, the mortgage industry has operated within a boom and bust cycle,” Pruitt said. “The great promise of Candor is to smooth out the boom and bust cycle — so you don’t have to staff up when the next refinance boom hits, because so much of the work is automated.” Candor also takes the guesswork out of approval, helping UpEquity find even greater success competing with cash offers.
